documentation.content:
An execution of the Cloud Run job saferoute-migrate ended as failed. The deploy run that started it has failed as well.

What to do: docs/runbooks/alerts-staging.md, section "When an alert arrives". Do not paste project ids, URLs or tokens when asking for help.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "saferoute-migrate" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
